title: Pinklion's 3D Resource Blocks
description: I made models for the resource blocks in Minecraft like the diamond block or iron block.
body:
![The logo for the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c8d95274f7e6f9728b727e75246e2a09754e3f3.png)In this pack I made 3D models for the resource blocks in Minecraft. The blocks I moddeled are blocks like the copper block, diamond block, iron block, and more.

Im stupid and don't know how to make a texture pack correctly so if you have another pack that changes the textures put it above this texture pack in the menu.
